spec.claim_summary: Buy when the daily close crosses above the 200-day moving average and liquidate when it falls back below it.

claimed.other: most recent trade that started after the crash of March 2020 returned 388%

assumptions: Asset is BTCUSDT from page context; the claim text alone names no asset.
Timeframe is daily from 'daily close' and checking price once a day.
Interpreted '200 days moving average' / '200 DMA' as 200-period simple moving average (sma).
Entry 'crossing above' compiled as crosses_above; exit 'falls back down below' compiled as crosses_below.
No stop, target, trailing stop or max hold stated; exit is indicator cross only.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: none; rule uses only close and sma available in schema.
388% refers to a single trade starting after March 2020 crash, stored in claimed.other, not total strategy return.

evidence.quote: Buy when the daily close is crossing above the 200 days moving average.
Liquidate the position when the daily close falls back down below the 200 DMA.
